1: teṣhāṁ niṣhṭhā tu kā kṛiṣhṇa sattvam āho rajas tamaḥ ||
2: tri-vidhā bhavati śhraddhā dehināṁ sā svabhāva-jā |
sāttvikī rājasī chaiva tāmasī cheti tāṁ śhṛiṇu ||
3: śhraddhā-mayo ‘yaṁ puruṣho yo yach-chhraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ ||
4: pretān bhūta-gaṇānśh chānye yajante tāmasā janāḥ ||
5: aśhāstra-vihitaṁ ghoraṁ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ |
6: māṁ chaivāntaḥ śharīra-sthaṁ tān viddhy āsura-niśhchayān ||
7: āhāras tv api sarvasya tri-vidho bhavati priyaḥ |
yajñas tapas tathā dānaṁ teṣhāṁ bhedam imaṁ śhṛiṇu ||
8: rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛidyā āhārāḥ sāttvika-priyāḥ ||
10: yāta-yāmaṁ gata-rasaṁ pūti paryuṣhitaṁ cha yat |
11: yaṣhṭavyam eveti manaḥ samādhāya sa sāttvikaḥ ||
12: abhisandhāya tu phalaṁ dambhārtham api chaiva yat |
ijyate bharata-śhreṣhṭha taṁ yajñaṁ viddhi rājasam ||
14: brahmacharyam ahinsā cha śhārīraṁ tapa uchyate ||
15: anudvega-karaṁ vākyaṁ satyaṁ priya-hitaṁ cha yat |
16: bhāva-sanśhuddhir ity etat tapo mānasam uchyate ||
17: śhraddhayā parayā taptaṁ tapas tat tri-vidhaṁ naraiḥ |
18: kriyate tad iha proktaṁ rājasaṁ chalam adhruvam ||
20: deśhe kāle cha pātre cha tad dānaṁ sāttvikaṁ smṛitam ||
21: yat tu pratyupakārārthaṁ phalam uddiśhya vā punaḥ |
dīyate cha parikliṣhṭaṁ tad dānaṁ rājasaṁ smṛitam ||
22: adeśha-kāle yad dānam apātrebhyaśh cha dīyate |
23: oṁ tat sad iti nirdeśho brahmaṇas tri-vidhaḥ smṛitaḥ |
brāhmaṇās tena vedāśh cha yajñāśh cha vihitāḥ purā ||
26: sad-bhāve sādhu-bhāve cha sad ity etat prayujyate |
praśhaste karmaṇi tathā sach-chhabdaḥ pārtha yujyate ||
27: yajñe tapasi dāne cha sthitiḥ sad iti chochyate |
karma chaiva tad-arthīyaṁ sad ity evābhidhīyate ||
28: aśhraddhayā hutaṁ dattaṁ tapas taptaṁ kṛitaṁ cha yat |
asad ity uchyate pārtha na cha tat pretya no iha ||
